title: Causal Edit Serialization
abstract: arXiv:2610.22820v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Standard autoregressive language models generate text sequentially, but revision requires referring back to tokens in the input context or those already generated. Causal Edit Serialization (CES) is introduced as a framework for expressing such revisions within the same causal token stream. Special pointer tokens are paired with predicted source addresses, allowing insertion, deletion, replacement, copying and movement to be localized explicitly. A lightweight localization head and dual-index rotary position encoding support both address prediction and conditioning on previously emitted pointers, while retaining a standard causal attention mask. A pretraining procedure combines ordinary language modeling with serialized repairs derived from random corruptions, model-generated edits and repeated text. translated_abstract: 标准自回归语言模型按顺序生成文本，但修订操作需要回溯引用输入上下文中的词元或已生成的词元。本文提出了因果编辑序列化（CES）框架，用于在同一个因果词元流中表达此类修订。特殊的指针词元与预测的源地址相配对，使得插入、删除、替换、复制和移动等操作能够被显式地定位。轻量级的定位头与双索引旋转位置编码既支持地址预测，也支持对先前发出的指针进行条件化处理，同时保留了标准的因果注意力掩码。预训练过程将普通语言建模与序列化修复任务相结合，这些修复任务来源于随机损坏、模型生成的编辑以及重复文本。在多种模型规模和编辑基线的对比中，CES模型能够完整地执行编辑操作，同时在干净文本上每字节的比特数仅略有增加。
tldr: 提出因果编辑序列化（CES）框架，通过指针词元、轻量级定位头和双索引旋转位置编码，使自回归语言模型能够在保持标准因果注意力机制的前提下，对文本进行插入、删除、替换、复制和移动等显式编辑操作。
en_tdlr: Proposes Causal Edit Serialization (CES), a framework enabling autoregressive language models to explicitly perform insertion, deletion, replacement, copying and movement edits within a causal token stream, using pointer tokens, a lightweight localization head, and dual-index rotary position encoding while retaining standard causal attention.
